breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use pimpleFoam for both fluid and solid regions on a combined mesh with no explicit coupling,' which directly repeats the original error. The ground truth requires a separate solid solver (e.g., solidDisplacementFoam) and two-way FSI coupling exchanging displacement and traction (e.g., via solids4foam or preCICE). The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
